purpose.statement: PAUDBLOD is an IMS batch load program that reads sequential flat files containing Pending Authorization Summary (root) segments and Pending Authorization Detail (child) segments, then inserts them into an IMS database using DL/I calls via CBLTDLI. The program is designed to bulk-load the IMS hierarchical database PAUTBPCB with root (PAUTSUM0) and child (PAUTDTL1) segment data extracted from sequential input files.

code_references.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PAUDBLOD.

MAIN-PARA.
            ENTRY 'DLITCBL'                 USING PAUTBPCB.
            DISPLAY 'STARTING PAUDBLOD'.
           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE                THRU 1000-EXIT
           PERFORM 2000-READ-ROOT-SEG-FILE        THRU 2000-EXIT
           UNTIL   END-ROOT-SEG-FILE  = 'Y'
           PERFORM 3000-READ-CHILD-SEG-FILE       THRU 3000-EXIT
           UNTIL   END-CHILD-SEG-FILE = 'Y'
           PERFORM 4000-FILE-CLOSE THRU 4000-EXIT
           GOBACK.

PROCEDURE DIVISION                  USING IO-PCB-MASK
                                                 PAUTBPCB.

business_rules.statement: A root segment record read from INFILE1 is only inserted into the IMS database if the file status is SPACES or '00' (successful read). If the file status is '10', end-of-file is signalled. Any other status is treated as an error.

code_references.snippet:
IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
               MOVE INFIL1-REC TO PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
               PERFORM 2100-INSERT-ROOT-SEG THRU 2100-EXIT
            ELSE
               IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS = '10'
                  MOVE 'Y' TO END-ROOT-SEG-FILE
               ELSE
                  DISPLAY 'ERROR READING ROOT SEG INFILE'
               END-IF
            END-IF.

business_rules.statement: A root segment (PAUTSUM0) is inserted into IMS using an ISRT DL/I call with an unqualified SSA. If the IMS PCB status after insert is spaces (success) or 'II' (duplicate segment already in DB), processing continues normally. Any other PCB status code triggers an abend.

code_references.snippet:
CALL 'CBLTDLI'       USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
                                        ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA.
            IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = SPACES
               DISPLAY 'ROOT INSERT SUCCESS    '
            END-IF
            IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = 'II'
               DISPLAY 'ROOT SEGMENT ALREADY IN DB'
            END-IF
            IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'II'
                  DISPLAY 'ROOT INSERT FAILED  :' PAUT-PCB-STATUS
                  PERFORM 9999-ABEND
            END-IF

business_rules.statement: A child segment record from INFILE2 is only processed if the file status is SPACES or '00', AND the ROOT-SEG-KEY field is NUMERIC. If ROOT-SEG-KEY is not numeric, the record is silently skipped. End-of-file ('10') sets the end-child flag; any other status is flagged as an error.

code_references.snippet:
IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
               IF ROOT-SEG-KEY IS NUMERIC
               MOVE ROOT-SEG-KEY  TO QUAL-SSA-KEY-VALUE
               MOVE CHILD-SEG-REC TO PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
               PERFORM 3100-INSERT-CHILD-SEG THRU 3100-EXIT
               END-IF
            ELSE
               IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS = '10'
                  MOVE 'Y' TO END-CHILD-SEG-FILE
               ELSE
                  DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CHILD SEG INFILE'
               END-IF
            END-IF.

business_rules.statement: Before inserting a child segment (PAUTDTL1), the program must first successfully locate the parent root segment using a qualified Get Unique (GU) DL/I call against PAUTSUM0, keyed by the ROOT-SEG-KEY (ACCNTID). Only if the GU call returns a spaces status (success) is the child insert performed. A non-spaces, non-'II' GU status triggers an abend.

code_references.snippet:
INITIALIZE PAUT-PCB-STATUS
            CALL 'CBLTDLI'       USING  FUNC-GU
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
                                        ROOT-QUAL-SSA.
               IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = SPACES
                  DISPLAY 'GU CALL TO ROOT SEG SUCCESS'
                  PERFORM 3200-INSERT-IMS-CALL  THRU 3200-EXIT
               IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'II'
                  DISPLAY 'ROOT GU CALL FAIL:' PAUT-PCB-STATUS
                  DISPLAY 'KFB AREA IN CHILD:' PAUT-KEYFB
                    PERFORM 9999-ABEND
               END-IF.

business_rules.statement: The qualified SSA for the root segment GU call uses segment name PAUTSUM0, key field ACCNTID, and relational operator EQ, with the key value populated from the ROOT-SEG-KEY field of INFILE2.

code_references.snippet:
01 ROOT-QUAL-SSA.
          05 QUAL-SSA-SEG-NAME      PIC X(08) VALUE 'PAUTSUM0'.
          05 FILLER                 PIC X(01) VALUE '('.
          05 QUAL-SSA-KEY-FIELD     PIC X(08) VALUE 'ACCNTID '.
          05 QUAL-SSA-REL-OPER      PIC X(02) VALUE 'EQ'.
          05 QUAL-SSA-KEY-VALUE     PIC S9(11) COMP-3.
          05 FILLER                 PIC X(01) VALUE ')'.
MOVE ROOT-SEG-KEY  TO QUAL-SSA-KEY-VALUE

business_rules.statement: The child segment ISRT DL/I call uses an unqualified SSA for PAUTDTL1. A spaces PCB status indicates success; 'II' indicates the child already exists in the database. Any other status triggers an abend with the key feedback area displayed.

code_references.snippet:
CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
                                        CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA.
            IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = SPACES
               DISPLAY 'CHILD SEGMENT INSERTED SUCCESS'
            END-IF
            IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = 'II'
               DISPLAY 'CHILD SEGMENT ALREADY IN DB'
            END-IF
            IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'II'
                  DISPLAY 'INSERT CALL FAIL FOR CHILD:' PAUT-PCB-STATUS
                  DISPLAY 'KFB AREA IN CHILD:' PAUT-KEYFB
                    PERFORM 9999-ABEND
            END-IF.

business_rules.statement: If either INFILE1 or INFILE2 cannot be opened successfully (file status not SPACES or '00'), the program immediately abends via 9999-ABEND.

code_references.snippet:
OPEN INPUT  INFILE1
           IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
              CONTINUE
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'ERROR IN OPENING INFILE1:' WS-INFIL1-STATUS
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND
           END-IF
           OPEN INPUT INFILE2
           IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
              CONTINUE
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'ERROR IN OPENING INFILE2:' WS-INFIL2-STATUS
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND
           END-IF.

business_rules.statement: The program processes all root segments before processing any child segments — the entire INFILE1 root-load loop completes to end-of-file before the INFILE2 child-load loop begins.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM 2000-READ-ROOT-SEG-FILE        THRU 2000-EXIT
           UNTIL   END-ROOT-SEG-FILE  = 'Y'

           PERFORM 3000-READ-CHILD-SEG-FILE       THRU 3000-EXIT
           UNTIL   END-CHILD-SEG-FILE = 'Y'

inputs.statement: INFILE1 is a sequential flat file containing Pending Authorization Summary (root segment) records, each 100 bytes wide. Each record is read and loaded as a PAUTSUM0 root segment into IMS.

code_references.snippet:
SELECT INFILE1 ASSIGN TO INFILE1
           ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
           ACCESS MODE  IS SEQUENTIAL
           FILE STATUS IS WS-INFIL1-STATUS.

FD INFILE1.
       01 INFIL1-REC                    PIC X(100).

inputs.statement: INFILE2 is a sequential flat file containing Pending Authorization Detail (child segment) records. Each record consists of an 11-digit packed-decimal ROOT-SEG-KEY (ACCNTID, 6 bytes COMP-3) used to link to the parent root segment, followed by 200 bytes of child segment data (CHILD-SEG-REC).

code_references.snippet:
SELECT INFILE2 ASSIGN TO INFILE2
           ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
           ACCESS MODE  IS SEQUENTIAL
           FILE STATUS IS WS-INFIL2-STATUS.

FD INFILE2.
       01 INFIL2-REC.
          05 ROOT-SEG-KEY               PIC S9(11) COMP-3.
          05 CHILD-SEG-REC              PIC X(200).

inputs.statement: PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY is the IMS root segment layout for PAUTSUM0, defined via the CIPAUSMY copybook, used as the I/O area for root segment DL/I calls.

code_references.snippet:
01 PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY.
       COPY CIPAUSMY.

inputs.statement: PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS is the IMS child segment layout for PAUTDTL1, defined via the CIPAUDTY copybook, used as the I/O area for child segment DL/I calls.

code_references.snippet:
01 PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS.
       COPY CIPAUDTY.

outputs.statement: The IMS database accessed via PAUTBPCB (Program Communication Block) is the sole output. Root segments (PAUTSUM0) and child segments (PAUTDTL1) are inserted into this IMS hierarchical database using CBLTDLI DL/I calls.

code_references.snippet:
01 IO-PCB-MASK   PIC X(1).
       COPY PAUTBPCB.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION                  USING IO-PCB-MASK
                                                 PAUTBPCB.

CALL 'CBLTDLI'       USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
                                        ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA.

CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
                                        CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA.

outputs.statement: Console/SYSOUT messages are produced throughout processing to report progress, success, duplicate detection, errors, and abend conditions.

code_references.snippet:
IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = SPACES
               DISPLAY 'ROOT INSERT SUCCESS    '
            END-IF
            IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = 'II'
               DISPLAY 'ROOT SEGMENT ALREADY IN DB'
            END-IF
            IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'II'
                  DISPLAY 'ROOT INSERT FAILED  :' PAUT-PCB-STATUS
                  PERFORM 9999-ABEND
            END-IF

processing_logic.statement: Step 1 – Initialization (1000-INITIALIZE): Accept current date and Julian day from the system. Display the current date. Open INFILE1 and INFILE2 for sequential input; abend if either fails to open.

code_references.snippet:
ACCEPT CURRENT-DATE     FROM DATE
           ACCEPT CURRENT-YYDDD    FROM DAY
           DISPLAY '*-------------------------------------*'
           DISPLAY 'TODAYS DATE            :' CURRENT-DATE
           OPEN INPUT  INFILE1
           IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
              CONTINUE
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'ERROR IN OPENING INFILE1:' WS-INFIL1-STATUS
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND
           END-IF
           OPEN INPUT INFILE2
           ...

processing_logic.statement: Step 2 – Root Segment Load Loop (2000-READ-ROOT-SEG-FILE / 2100-INSERT-ROOT-SEG): Sequentially read each record from INFILE1. For each successful read, move the 100-byte record to PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY and call 2100-INSERT-ROOT-SEG to perform an IMS ISRT of the PAUTSUM0 root segment using an unqualified SSA. Continue until end-of-file on INFILE1.

code_references.snippet:
READ INFILE1
            IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
               MOVE INFIL1-REC TO PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
               PERFORM 2100-INSERT-ROOT-SEG THRU 2100-EXIT
            ELSE
               IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS = '10'
                  MOVE 'Y' TO END-ROOT-SEG-FILE
               ...

CALL 'CBLTDLI'       USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
                                        ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA.
            ...

processing_logic.statement: Step 3 – Child Segment Load Loop (3000-READ-CHILD-SEG-FILE / 3100-INSERT-CHILD-SEG / 3200-INSERT-IMS-CALL): After all root segments are loaded, sequentially read each record from INFILE2. For each valid record where ROOT-SEG-KEY is numeric, move the key to the qualified SSA and the child data to PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS. Issue a GU (Get Unique) DL/I call to position on the parent root segment; if successful, issue an ISRT DL/I call to insert the PAUTDTL1 child segment. Continue until end-of-file on INFILE2.

code_references.snippet:
READ INFILE2
            IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
               IF ROOT-SEG-KEY IS NUMERIC
               MOVE ROOT-SEG-KEY  TO QUAL-SSA-KEY-VALUE
               MOVE CHILD-SEG-REC TO PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
               PERFORM 3100-INSERT-CHILD-SEG THRU 3100-EXIT
               END-IF
            ...

INITIALIZE PAUT-PCB-STATUS
            CALL 'CBLTDLI'       USING  FUNC-GU
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
                                        ROOT-QUAL-SSA.
               IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = SPACES
                  PERFORM 3200-INSERT-IMS-CALL  THRU 3200-EXIT
               ...

CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
                                        CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA.

processing_logic.statement: Step 4 – File Close (4000-FILE-CLOSE): Close INFILE1 and INFILE2. Display a warning message if either close operation returns a non-zero/non-blank file status, but do not abend.

code_references.snippet:
DISPLAY 'CLOSING THE FILE'
            CLOSE INFILE1.
            IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
             CONTINUE
            ELSE
             DISPLAY 'ERROR IN CLOSING 1ST FILE:'WS-INFIL1-STATUS
            END-IF.
            CLOSE INFILE2.
            IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
             CONTINUE
            ELSE
             DISPLAY 'ERROR IN CLOSING 2ND FILE:'WS-INFIL2-STATUS
            END-IF.

processing_logic.statement: Step 5 – Program Termination: After file close, control returns to IMS via GOBACK.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM 4000-FILE-CLOSE THRU 4000-EXIT
           GOBACK.

dependencies.statement: CBLTDLI is the IBM IMS DL/I callable interface module used for all database interactions (ISRT and GU function calls). It is called externally by name string.

code_references.snippet:
CALL 'CBLTDLI'       USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
                                        ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA.

CALL 'CBLTDLI'       USING  FUNC-GU
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
                                        ROOT-QUAL-SSA.

CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
                                        CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA.

dependencies.statement: IMSFUNCS copybook provides the DL/I function code constants (FUNC-ISRT, FUNC-GU, etc.) used in all CBLTDLI calls.

code_references.snippet: COPY IMSFUNCS.

dependencies.statement: CIPAUSMY copybook defines the layout of the IMS Pending Authorization Summary root segment (PAUTSUM0), used as the I/O area in root segment DL/I calls.

code_references.snippet:
01 PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY.
       COPY CIPAUSMY.

dependencies.statement: CIPAUDTY copybook defines the layout of the IMS Pending Authorization Details child segment (PAUTDTL1), used as the I/O area in child segment DL/I calls.

code_references.snippet:
01 PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS.
       COPY CIPAUDTY.

dependencies.statement: PAUTBPCB copybook defines the IMS Program Communication Block (PCB) mask used to communicate with IMS, providing status codes (PAUT-PCB-STATUS), segment names (PAUT-SEG-NAME), and key feedback areas (PAUT-KEYFB).

code_references.snippet:
01 IO-PCB-MASK   PIC X(1).
       COPY PAUTBPCB.

dependencies.statement: The IMS database accessed via PAUTBPCB contains the PAUTSUM0 (Pending Authorization Summary) and PAUTDTL1 (Pending Authorization Details) segment types in a parent-child hierarchy keyed by ACCNTID.

code_references.snippet:
01 ROOT-QUAL-SSA.
          05 QUAL-SSA-SEG-NAME      PIC X(08) VALUE 'PAUTSUM0'.
          05 QUAL-SSA-KEY-FIELD     PIC X(08) VALUE 'ACCNTID '.
          05 QUAL-SSA-REL-OPER      PIC X(02) VALUE 'EQ'.

01 ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA.
          05 FILLER                 PIC X(08) VALUE 'PAUTSUM0'.
          05 FILLER                 PIC X(01) VALUE ' '.

01 CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA.
          05 FILLER                 PIC X(08) VALUE 'PAUTDTL1'.
          05 FILLER                 PIC X(01) VALUE ' '.

dependencies.statement: The program uses the IMS DLITCBL entry point convention, registering itself with IMS via ENTRY 'DLITCBL' USING PAUTBPCB, which is the standard IMS batch program scheduling mechanism.

code_references.snippet: ENTRY 'DLITCBL'                 USING PAUTBPCB.

error_handling.statement: 9999-ABEND is the centralized abend routine. It displays 'IMS LOAD ABENDING...', sets RETURN-CODE to 16, and issues GOBACK to terminate the program with a non-zero return code. It is called on file open failure, unexpected IMS PCB status on ISRT (root or child), and unexpected IMS PCB status on GU (parent lookup).

code_references.snippet:
9999-ABEND.
           DISPLAY 'IMS LOAD ABENDING ...'
           MOVE 16 TO RETURN-CODE
           GOBACK.

error_handling.statement: File open errors for INFILE1 or INFILE2 are detected by checking the file status variable after OPEN. A non-blank, non-'00' status causes an immediate call to 9999-ABEND.

code_references.snippet:
OPEN INPUT  INFILE1
           IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
              CONTINUE
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'ERROR IN OPENING INFILE1:' WS-INFIL1-STATUS
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND
           END-IF
           OPEN INPUT INFILE2
           IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
              CONTINUE
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'ERROR IN OPENING INFILE2:' WS-INFIL2-STATUS
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND
           END-IF.

error_handling.statement: IMS PCB status codes are checked after every DL/I call. The values SPACES (success) and 'II' (duplicate key) are treated as non-fatal. Any other status code on a root ISRT triggers an abend with the status displayed.

code_references.snippet:
IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'II'
                  DISPLAY 'ROOT INSERT FAILED  :' PAUT-PCB-STATUS
                  PERFORM 9999-ABEND
            END-IF

error_handling.statement: If the GU DL/I call to locate a parent root segment fails with a status other than SPACES or 'II', the program displays the failing PCB status and the IMS key feedback area (PAUT-KEYFB), then calls 9999-ABEND.

code_references.snippet:
IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'II'
                  DISPLAY 'ROOT GU CALL FAIL:' PAUT-PCB-STATUS
                  DISPLAY 'KFB AREA IN CHILD:' PAUT-KEYFB
                    PERFORM 9999-ABEND
               END-IF.

error_handling.statement: If the child ISRT DL/I call fails with a status other than SPACES or 'II', the program displays the failing PCB status and the IMS key feedback area, then calls 9999-ABEND.

code_references.snippet:
IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'II'
                  DISPLAY 'INSERT CALL FAIL FOR CHILD:' PAUT-PCB-STATUS
                  DISPLAY 'KFB AREA IN CHILD:' PAUT-KEYFB
                    PERFORM 9999-ABEND
            END-IF.

error_handling.statement: Read errors on INFILE1 (status not '00', SPACES, or '10') are reported via DISPLAY but do not trigger an abend; the loop continues. Similarly, read errors on INFILE2 are reported via DISPLAY without abending.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE
               IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS = '10'
                  MOVE 'Y' TO END-ROOT-SEG-FILE
               ELSE
                  DISPLAY 'ERROR READING ROOT SEG INFILE'
               END-IF

ELSE
               IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS = '10'
                  MOVE 'Y' TO END-CHILD-SEG-FILE
               ELSE
                  DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CHILD SEG INFILE'
               END-IF

error_handling.statement: File close errors for INFILE1 or INFILE2 are detected and reported via DISPLAY, but the program does not abend on close failure; it continues to normal termination.

code_references.snippet:
IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
             CONTINUE
            ELSE
             DISPLAY 'ERROR IN CLOSING 1ST FILE:'WS-INFIL1-STATUS
            END-IF.
            ...
            IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS =  SPACES OR '00'
             CONTINUE
            ELSE
             DISPLAY 'ERROR IN CLOSING 2ND FILE:'WS-INFIL2-STATUS
            END-IF.

error_handling.statement: The PAUT-PCB-STATUS is explicitly initialized (INITIALIZE) before each child-level GU DL/I call to prevent stale status codes from a prior call affecting conditional logic.

code_references.snippet: INITIALIZE PAUT-PCB-STATUS

downstream_effects.statement: The IMS database (PAUTBPCB) is populated with Pending Authorization Summary root segments (PAUTSUM0), making these records available to downstream IMS-based authorization inquiry and processing programs within the CardDemo application.

code_references.snippet:
CALL 'CBLTDLI'       USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
                                        ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA.

downstream_effects.statement: The IMS database (PAUTBPCB) is populated with Pending Authorization Detail child segments (PAUTDTL1) subordinate to their respective parent PAUTSUM0 root segments, enabling downstream programs to retrieve complete authorization detail histories by account ID.

code_references.snippet:
CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING  FUNC-ISRT
                                        PAUTBPCB
                                        PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
                                        CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA.

downstream_effects.statement: The program acts as a data migration or initial load utility; its output (populated IMS segments) supports subsequent real-time or batch authorization processes in the CardDemo application that query pending authorization records by ACCNTID.

code_references.snippet:
01 ROOT-QUAL-SSA.
          05 QUAL-SSA-SEG-NAME      PIC X(08) VALUE 'PAUTSUM0'.
          05 QUAL-SSA-KEY-FIELD     PIC X(08) VALUE 'ACCNTID '.
          05 QUAL-SSA-REL-OPER      PIC X(02) VALUE 'EQ'.
          05 QUAL-SSA-KEY-VALUE     PIC S9(11) COMP-3.

downstream_effects.statement: Any abend condition (RETURN-CODE = 16 from 9999-ABEND) will cause the job step to fail, potentially halting dependent downstream JCL job steps that rely on the IMS database being fully loaded by this program.

code_references.snippet:
9999-ABEND.
           DISPLAY 'IMS LOAD ABENDING ...'
           MOVE 16 TO RETURN-CODE
           GOBACK.
